title: DC-area forecast: Muggy with a shower or storm possible this afternoon. Refreshing tomorrow.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly to mostly sunny and muggy this afternoon. Highs reach the mid- to upper 80s with few isolated showers or storms possible.

What’s next? A cold front comes through tonight, setting the stage for a mostly sunny and rather refreshing Monday and Tuesday with low humidity and highs near 80. Trending warmer and eventually more humid midweek.

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: A hard one to love with some afternoon heat and a soupy feel. At least there's sun? | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): Partly to mostly sunny skies help afternoon highs to the mid- to upper 80s. With high humidity (dew points in the low 70s) you might as well forget about your hair today. Could see a few isolated afternoon showers and storms. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Partly cloudy and still humid through the evening with the chance of an isolated shower or storm. A cold front moves through overnight, sending humidity lower by morning, with lows in the mid-60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): It’s a pleasant start to the work and school week, with mostly sunny skies and highs in the upper 70s to low 80s. Much drier air arrives (dew points fall back into the 50s during the day), making for a much more comfortable feel. Winds are somewhat breezy from the northwest, gusting near 20 mph at times. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: With clear skies, it’s a great night for an evening stroll as temperatures drop back through the 70s into the 60s. The fall-like feel continues overnight with lows in the 50s, maybe even some upper 40s north and west of the Beltway. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Tuesday and Wednesday feature mostly sunny skies as high pressure remains nearby. Highs in the upper 70s to low 80s Tuesday, then mid-80s on Wednesday with humidity starting to trend higher later in the day. Nighttime lows are mainly in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Partly to mostly sunny Thursday with highs in the mid- to upper 80s as humidity climbs back up into the moderate range. An approaching front could bring a chance for an isolated late-day shower or storm. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 13

Rain from the powerful 1944 Great Atlantic Hurricane set a daily record locally, while the storm caused catastrophic winds and damage farther up the East Coast.
